title: Scorpio Is Typing…
old_caption: Scorpio typed for twenty minutes, sent "nvm", then sent the bravest sentence in the whole chat. Which sign takes the longest to hit send?

title: Aquarius Renamed the Chat
old_caption: Aquarius fixed a bike light and assumed that said everything. The chat suggested one more step: saying why out loud. Which sign shows love by fixing things?

title: Virgo Needs Advice
old_caption: Virgo always has the answer, until the crush is Virgo's. The chat answered with Virgo's own advice, word for word. Who gives your chat its best advice?

title: Taurus Replied to Monday
old_caption: Taurus answered Monday's soup question on Thursday, and meant it. Then kept the usual date spot and added a new one. Which sign replies four days later?

title: Sag Was Honest. Very.
old_caption: Sag told a date the dinner was a bit salty. True, but the chat had notes: lead with what you loved. Ever been honest a little too fast?

title: Scorpio Asked Everyone
old_caption: Scorpio asked everyone what makes their day better, totally not because of the gift exchange. Your turn: what small thing makes yours?

title: Libra Practises Hello
old_caption: Libra drafted forty greetings for the party. Virgo got it down to one line. Who's rehearsing hello in your group chat?

title: Plus one?
old_caption: Libra is hosting the party and the crush already RSVP'd as a guest. Can the host have a plus one? Gemini answered three messages at once. Virgo said ask, then let them pick. They picked date. Who's your chat's Libra?

title: Family on video
old_caption: Ten minutes to meet the family on video. Capricorn sent an agenda, Aries said be loud. One question about the garden and grandma was sold. Who's your chat's calm one before big calls?

title: No context
old_caption: Sag dropped a map pin and nothing else. The chat guessed three places in one bubble. Virgo's tip: surprise them with the place, let them keep the weekend. Which sign sends pins with no context?
